verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user import/export via its Management API and migration tools (auth0-docs-11, auth0-docs-46), and its MCP server lets AI agents perform 'complex, multi-step operations' like creating apps or managing users (auth0-docs-41, auth0-gh-1), suggesting some automation depth for AI-native workflows. However, there's no explicit documentation showing an AI agent invoking true bulk/batch operations (e.g., updating hundreds of users or apps in one call) via MCP or API—only multi-step, single-item style operations. Missing for 10: explicit AI-driven bulk operation examples across many items, evidence of batch API endpoints exposed through MCP, and independent confirmation of this working in practice.
